name: TURTLE_SAM_01
blurb: Armor-wall turtle — twin heavy tanks, a SAM screen, twin howitzers. The comp that swept offense.

name: AIR_WING_01
blurb: Air wing — twin gunships strike from the sky while a heavy anchor and an artillery backfield hold the ground.

name: LIGHT_SWARM_01
blurb: Light swarm — fast light raiders kite ahead of a triple-artillery backline that does the killing.

name: ENERGY_LANCE_01
blurb: Energy lance — every barrel fires Energy to strip shields, a Commander refreshing its own.

name: EXPLOSIVE_SATURATION_01
blurb: Explosive saturation — demolition guns, rocket barrages and howitzers bury the front in splash.

name: MECH_PHALANX_01
blurb: Mech phalanx — three mechs brawl behind reactive plating, a rocket barrage and a healing Commander behind.

name: COMBINED_ARMS_01
blurb: Combined arms — a kinetic heavy anchor, an energy mech, an explosive backline and a gunship flank.

name: SHIELD_WALL_01
blurb: Shield wall — every hull runs a shield, a Commander topping them off. Grinds the clock down.

name: FLANK_RAIDERS_01
blurb: Flank raiders — a light raider and a mech striker knife the front behind a heavy anchor and twin backline.

name: INTERCEPTOR_SCREEN_01
blurb: Interceptor screen — two fighters and a single SAM screen a rocket line. Air-leaning, not all-in.

name: RAILGUN_LINE_01
blurb: Railgun line — a three-wide kinetic front punches through armor, a flechette SAM overhead.

name: GUARDIAN_COLUMN_01
blurb: Guardian column — a healing Commander and a deep artillery backfield outlast burst damage.
